<b>Queen's Egg</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is not obtainable during {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]].

== Use ==
The Queen's Egg is a fragile item given by [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]] that needs to be transported for the [[Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wish]] <i>[[Queen's Egg (Wish)|Queen's Egg]]</i>. It has four hit points, which decrease when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] takes damage, makes a heavy landing, collides into a wall while using [[Swift Step]], or collides into a ceiling while using [[Silk Soar]]. It is immediately destroyed if Hornet travels with the [[Bellways]], [[Ventrica]], [[Flea Caravan]], or [[Beastling Call]]. It is to be delivered to [[Styx]] in [[Sinner's Road]]. After that is done it will be added to the [[Materium]], and Styx will upgrade his [[Silkeater]] farm, now capable of holding a maximum of two Silkeaters at a time.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Styx.png!Styx's location in Sinner's Road

}}

== How to Acquire ==
After obtaining a [[Silkeater]] from [[Styx]] and fulfilling at least one other Delivery Wish, the Queen's Egg becomes available as part of one of the Delivery Wishes of Couriers Tipp & Pill. If the currently held one is destroyed, Hornet can return to Tipp & Pill to obtain another and try again.
